narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -8.70 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.5423-0.5511 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.5547; the first objective pays 0.84R at 0.5437.
